title: Cloud page writes: allow the cloud page tool, or keep page writes local
why: A cloud session's page writes can stall on an approval nobody sees, because the settings allow list names only the desktop connector's page tool.
source: Coordinator 20:07 and 20:08 CST Nov 11, page item 520
note: The settings allow list names only mcp__claude-artifacts__db_write (coordinator's read, 20:06 CST); cloud sessions use ArtifactData. A Degen cloud session saw page writes refused with reason mcpServerPolicy. Page item 520 asks the owner: a (recommended) keep page writes in a local session; b add ArtifactData to the allow list as a test (widens a shared tool). Under b, after the respawn a lane adds the one line and one cloud page write proves it. Waits for the fan-out (owner 13:51). Same name split as step page-tool-every-name.
